name: sol_integrations_balancer_1
description: Balancer flash loan repayment omits protocol fee, causing insolvent repayment if fees are later enabled
question: The source file in `source` implements a `receiveFlashLoan` (or equivalent Balancer flash loan callback) that repays only the borrowed principal amounts back to the vault and ignores or discards the `feeAmounts` parameter supplied by Balancer, so that if Balancer ever charges a nonzero flash loan fee the repayment transferred will be insufficient to cover principal plus fee, excluding implementations that explicitly add each corresponding feeAmounts[i] to the transferred repayment for every borrowed token.
criteria: receiveFlashLoan transfers tokens[i] amounts[i] back to the vault without adding feeAmounts[i]
The callback function signature includes a feeAmounts array parameter that is never read or used in computing the repayment amount
Repayment logic hardcodes repayment as the original borrowed amount, ignoring any additional fee component from the vault
